proves.claim: clause 1: clearReservation removes an item reservation set by reserveItem and refuses with a next step when none is set.

moves.clear-reservation.removes-and-refu.why: A reservation that cannot be cleared, or a clear that silently does nothing, would leave an item misrouted.

proves.claim: clause 2: the item history records the reservation after reserveItem and its absence after clearReservation.

moves.clear-reservation.history-shows-bo.why: Replicas replay the event history, so a clear that leaves no event would leave replicas holding the reservation.
